programme.title: 洪拳與詠春
programme.desc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇。

programme.title: 鬼畫符

programme.title: 邪完再邪

programme.title: 鏢旗飛揚

programme.title: 拳擊

programme.title: 無名英雄

programme.title: 風雲第一刀
programme.desc: 五年前,江湖第一大幫鎮魔幫因勢力讓朝廷忌憚,幫主龍嘯天為保江湖穩定,天下太平,宣佈解散鎮魔幫,而有江湖第一刀之稱的伏魔寶刀也隨之消失於江湖。五年後,早已隱居的龍嘯天因夫人被抓,被逼出山刺殺李世民。而心懷叵測的副幫主曹睿偷襲龍嘯天,奪下了伏魔

programme.title: 九紋龍史進之除惡史家村
programme.desc: 史家莊少莊主史進年輕氣盛,俠肝義膽。年輕時拜師七人,每拜一師便在身上紋一條青龍。不料第八位師父陰狠險惡,險些釀的他家破人亡。幸虧得到恩師王進得救,手刃了仇人,史進紋得第九條青龍。

programme.title: 奪魂異陣圖

programme.desc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #5
programme.desc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案

programme.title: 明猩學園 #6

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 英普
programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況

programme.title: 上城水獭 #2 英普
programme.desc: 隨著海灣家族一起逆流而上,在這裡安娜幫忙撫養她的孫輩,然後回老家找出入侵她的地盤的傢伙們親眼目睹紅樹林裡的洪水差點把一個嬰兒沖走,看著城裡人家族利用牠們的資源享受乾淨食物

programme.title: 風之島 #6 英普
programme.desc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家

programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #4
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力

programme.title: 袋熊異聞錄 #1
programme.desc: 在澳洲東南部大雪山的涼爽高地,有一片被稱為袋熊林的大型林地在樹叢中點綴著茂密的樹葉,可看到過百個地洞,袋熊在白天溫暖時都躲於其中睡覺

programme.title: 動物王國 #3
programme.desc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種這些主要被稱為牲畜,負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅

programme.title: 靈長大地 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源

programme.title: 靈長大地 #2
programme.desc: 這島是狐猴的天地狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小,顏色和形狀都有

programme.title: 靈長大地 #3
programme.desc: 位於南非的霍格斯巴克,有兩種迷人的靈長類動物棲居其中:長尾猴和開普鸚鵡窺探牠們如何克服棲息地日益萎縮的困境,並充分利用機會,穿越城鎮尋找食物

programme.title: 靈長大地 #4
programme.desc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉但繁華背後卻有一個問題--牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群

programme.title: 野性倖存者 #1
programme.desc: 繁殖的動力是自然界中最原始的力量之一它決定了任何物種終其一生大部分時間內的行為在非洲有超過十萬種動物,亦因此發展出無數尋找伴侶的策略一起見證棲居於尚比亞盧安瓜河谷的眾生,如何不惜一切延續血脈

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #4
programme.desc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #5
programme.desc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #6
programme.desc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴

programme.title: 上城水獭 #1 英普
programme.desc: 巡视「海灣」家族郁郁蔥蔥的領土,在這裡女族長安娜向族人提供奢華的盛宴,但也面臨著內部的異議打量她的對手米婭--頗具街頭智慧的「城裡人」家族領導者,她正在考慮改善生活方式,並向與世隔絕的「紅樹林」家族打探消息

programme.title: 上城水獭 #2 英普
programme.desc: 隨著海灣家族一起逆流而上,在這裡安娜幫忙撫養她的孫輩,然後回老家找出入侵她的地盤的傢伙們親眼目睹紅樹林裡的洪水差點把一個嬰兒沖走,看著城裡人家族利用牠們的資源享受乾淨食物

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 生命之旅 #1 英普
programme.desc: 撐過嬰兒期是地球上幾乎所有物種的最大挑戰在非洲荒野,生死的平衡很容易傾側,動物必須成長並迅速學習,才能度過生命的第一階段

programme.title: 生命之旅 #2 英普
programme.desc: 贊比亞的幼崽由成長至生育,皆面臨著巨大挑戰,每個教訓都意味著生死一線牠們成年的過程需要技巧,力量,勇氣和大量的運氣

programme.title: 生命之旅 #3 英普
programme.desc: 為了把基因傳承給下一代,動物在一生中歷盡史詩式的鬥爭只有最強壯和最有決心的才能覓得伴侶,為交配而戰,也只有最優秀的父母才能擁有讓幼崽存活的技能

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #2
programme.desc: 來看看工作人員照顧一隻被狗咬傷的小兔子,隨後加入該救援中心的放生團隊,將一隻被遺棄的小天鵝介紹給收養的天鵝媽媽,但是事情似乎沒有完全按照計劃進行

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題

programme.title: 明猩學園 #5
programme.desc: 搜尋失踪的孤兒拉黑伊,並見證害羞的魯姆巴在築巢課上,嘗試使用她虛弱的左手見證年輕的黛麗拉在課堂上如何教訓布米,並看看班尼和瓦倫蒂諾能否合格,最終贏得自由

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案

programme.desc: 巡视「海灣」家族郁郁蔥蔥的領土,在這裡女族長安娜向族人提供奢華的盛宴,但也面臨著內部的異議打量她的對手米婭--頗具街頭智慧的「城裡人」家族領導者,她正在考慮改善生活方式,並向與世隔絕的「紅樹林」家族打探消息

programme.desc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌

programme.title: 風之島 #5 英普
programme.desc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #5
programme.desc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #3
programme.desc: 加入尋找庫伯鷹的行動,牠剛剛在後院的泳池裡驚險的泡了個澡捕捉救援中心臭鼬的狂歡,但牠們似乎不願出鏡,這讓拍攝團隊有機會近距離體驗臭鼬的自然防禦能力

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案

programme.title: 明猩學園 #6
programme.desc: 恭喜明猩學園的應屆畢業生,並見證他們的茁壯成長!跟隨車隊前往典禮現場,見證團隊向每一位踏上新旅途的明猩朋友作真摯告別,然後舉行熱鬧的畢業慶祝活動!而莫莉和布米也成功升班

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #1 英普
programme.desc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #2 英普
programme.desc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況

programme.title: 上城水獭 #2 英普
programme.desc: 隨著海灣家族一起逆流而上,在這裡安娜幫忙撫養她的孫輩,然後回老家找出入侵她的地盤的傢伙們親眼目睹紅樹林裡的洪水差點把一個嬰兒沖走,看著城裡人家族利用牠們的資源享受乾淨食物

programme.title: 風之島 #6 英普
programme.desc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #4
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力

programme.title: 袋熊異聞錄 #1
programme.desc: 在澳洲東南部大雪山的涼爽高地,有一片被稱為袋熊林的大型林地在樹叢中點綴著茂密的樹葉,可看到過百個地洞,袋熊在白天溫暖時都躲於其中睡覺

programme.title: 動物王國 #3
programme.desc: 農場中的禽畜多是眾多歌曲和故事的主角,牠們在全球各地歡慶,但卻很少談起牠們在野外的兄弟姊妹物種這些主要被稱為牲畜,負軛的野獸,甚至寵物,必須在其家養親屬的圍欄外自生自滅

programme.title: 靈長大地 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源

programme.title: 靈長大地 #2
programme.desc: 這島是狐猴的天地狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小,顏色和形狀都有

programme.title: 靈長大地 #3
programme.desc: 位於南非的霍格斯巴克,有兩種迷人的靈長類動物棲居其中:長尾猴和開普鸚鵡窺探牠們如何克服棲息地日益萎縮的困境,並充分利用機會,穿越城鎮尋找食物

programme.title: 靈長大地 #4
programme.desc: 貝拉貝拉狒狒隊伍是一個成功的查克馬狒狒族群,牠們在南非沃特伯格山脈的一個原始山谷中開枝散葉但繁華背後卻有一個問題--牠們不是山谷中唯一的狒狒族群

programme.title: 野性倖存者 #1
programme.desc: 繁殖的動力是自然界中最原始的力量之一它決定了任何物種終其一生大部分時間內的行為在非洲有超過十萬種動物,亦因此發展出無數尋找伴侶的策略一起見證棲居於尚比亞盧安瓜河谷的眾生,如何不惜一切延續血脈

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #4
programme.desc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #5
programme.desc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #6
programme.desc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4

programme.title: 賀錦麗:明日傳奇
programme.desc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過,她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力

programme.title: 克林伊斯威特:自得其樂

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #2
programme.desc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #3
programme.desc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山,偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家它們就是迷人的義大利島國

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一通過新聞片段,任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #3

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #4

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers

programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

高朋滿座#137粵
programme.desc: 酒樓發生火警，朋被困在內，幪面男子將朋救出火場，傳媒形容他「幪面英雄」，而朋卻被挖苦成「為食阿伯」。眾人欲尋找這位「恩公」當面感謝他，結果溢在另一個火災現場找到這位叫萬洛的「英雄」，更帶他到家中作客。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#12粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕臨加冠之禮當日，雪寧送上寶劍作賀禮，薛燁卻突然發難，與燕臨起爭執，燕牧和謝危剛好趕到才平息。冠禮進行期間，薛遠率兵包圍眾人，稱燕家勾結叛黨，奉旨捉拿燕家人等。眾人急忙勸說，張遮更懷疑聖旨的真實性。

programme.title: 食平DD粵
programme.desc: 識食葡國菜的人，必揀葡燒乳豬全體，肥媽示範製作過程。要炮製非洲雞，需用到兩種意想不到的材料，到底是甚麼？肥媽傳授易做沙律，步驟和材料一目了然！另外，肥媽教做葡式的鴛鴦木糠蛋糕。

programme.title: 匠心新時代粵
programme.desc: 藝員孔德賢聯同來自電力、水喉、冷氣、項目監督、工藝測試等不同工種或崗位的精英，讓觀眾認識業界如何採用創新科技配合施工，並感受建築業「匠心」、「匠魂」、「匠技」、「匠行」的專業精神。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 隨着年齡增長，長者的皮膚逐漸退化，屏障變薄、油脂分泌減少，容易出現缺脂性濕疹、老人斑、灰指甲、帶狀疱疹的問題。皮膚科醫生到來，細說相關疾病的防治資訊。臨床心理學家指出，注意力可分為集中性、持續性、選擇性等多種類型。如注意力不集中，可能影響社交、降低工作效率、記憶力變差。他亦強調交替性與分配性注意力的重要性，並就提升孩子專注力提供建議。「睇餸食飯」環節，廚藝專家傅季馨示範一道「香茅白滷水豬手」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 美儀、麥包轉往佛山，有王敏慈加入「跟隊」。老城區活化後成潮人景點，中藥店「變身」咖啡店、以中式白酒調製雞尾酒的酒吧等，都甚吸引。燒鵝也有研究中心？主打燒鵝的食店，出品做到皮脆、肉嫩又多汁。坐上小型賽車，三主持極速分高下。洞穴式按摩店內，敏慈全身被埋進鹽堆中，感受如何？麥包帶兩位拍檔一秒前赴奈良？佛山的濕地公園亦可餵飼梅花鹿。行逛千燈湖夜市，麥包化身「猛男」沖檸檬茶！置身夢幻餐廳，竟是吃樹葉、木炭？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#19粵PG
programme.desc: 關仁帶眾人往石屋途中以唇語示警。君豪手下撲空，想殺淑滿，但被遠處伏擊的明翔阻止。關仁拆除淑滿身上炸藥對付君豪手下，但意外未能將已引爆的炸藥拋遠，譚彬飛撲救人受重傷。譚彬彌留前，江翹含淚戴上戒指。君豪約見江揚，展示可證明他無罪的影片，迫江揚捉高哲被拒。高哲使計令君豪欲活埋保全，再救回保全，但要他取出為江揚翻案的影片。保全潛入趙宅，得經琛相助取出影片，但逃脫時被君豪發現，君豪找勇哥買兇殺高哲等人。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 絕境求生天才戴雅與她的好友馬利，還有弟弟居禮一起上山捕蟲。突然間，他們被一道神秘的光芒包圍，身體更竟然變小了！這肯定是馬利的親戚歌博士的傑作，為了恢復原本的大小，戴雅一行決定前往歌博士的研究所。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這集兒童體適能教練會專注上半身的鍛練。第一節「上肢肌肉訓練」，紮好一個四平馬，做好抱拳的準備動作後，就可打出直拳；熟習後試試每次出拳都轉換雙腳擺放方向，出拳後還可連接收拳動作，串連整套練習就完成了。接着是「雙臂訓練」，放鬆站好，一隻手抱拳放腰側，另一隻手先後做出下擋、外擋、內擋、上擋。過程中，教練發覺小朋友有何常犯錯誤？另會播放AI生成動畫《掩耳盜鈴》的下半部。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 史納奇樂團四人想找出更有效收集音樂之力的方法。他們決定扮成女孩子進行調查。貝斯和多蘭發現唱歌跳舞以外的活動也能產生音樂之力；吉塔發現打扮也能提升音樂之力；卡利斯特則協助一位女孩的音樂之力成長。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 每屆的世界盃是足球界盛事，不少球迷熱烈捧場，1998年的世界盃，你是否有印象？新聞掏寶和大家重溫1998年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 宏利保險呈獻：掌握健康人生粵
匠心新時代粵
programme.desc: 藝員孔德賢聯同來自電力、水喉、冷氣、項目監督、工藝測試等不同工種或崗位的精英，讓觀眾認識業界如何採用創新科技配合施工，並感受建築業「匠心」、「匠魂」、「匠技」、「匠行」的專業精神。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主於二手網站購買演唱會門票時，遭賣方誘騙提交銀行資料並多次轉賬，損失逾十萬元。有服用情緒藥的女子在網上認識占卜師，對方聲稱可藉占卜治療其鼻疾，並要求她停服情緒藥，結果情緒問題加劇……男生於校內受到老師辱罵，嘗試以手機錄下證據，卻遭老師搶手機並強逼解鎖查閱私人內容。家長控訴該老師侵犯私隱，並有辱罵學生前科。而向教育局投訴後，其子反被校方以「情緒不穩」為由，要求社工介入評估。另帶來可改善灰甲的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2847粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 若水突然變得知慳識儉，懷疑與龔燁創業有關。樹根更發現龔燁斥巨資聘請名人為自家出品的龍鬚糖宣傳，覺得不值，於是嘗試設法幫他宣傳。龔燁在新威龍廣場擺攤出售龍鬚糖，樹根的努力帶來反效果，破壞龔燁的全盤大計。龔燁向樹根言明一切，希望樹根放手讓他自行解決此事。樹根找城安幫忙設法補救，被若水阻止，她提到慳錢的真正原因，並希望樹根放手讓他們夫妻面對挑戰。樹根嘗試放手，決意不再擅自為龔燁宣傳……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#9粵PG
programme.desc: 村長張建國德高望重，與妻子鄧淑嫻三代同堂。重男輕女的觀念，令孫女張帶弟備受冷待，孫兒張紹聰卻得全家寵愛。淑嫻視輕度弱智的兒子張宏智為珍寶，多年前利誘梁悅萍嫁給宏智，但悅萍入門後，婆媳關係漸趨惡劣。某日建國突然心臟病發暴斃，哪料到建國已立遺囑將所有財產交給紹聰！建國靈堂上，淑嫻誤會堂弟鄧向南與悅萍有染，質問下，悅萍驚爆紹聰的身世，張家上下震驚。紹聰一時間難以接受，激動下離家出走，誰知……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 寧波幫是中國近代最傳奇的商幫，在工商界貢獻非凡，師兄弟參觀寧波幫博物館，感受這份媲美江湖幫派的凝聚力，還向已故影視大亨六叔致敬。論到書香文化，全亞洲最古老的私人藏書樓「天一閣」則是寧波標誌之一，兩主持進內滋養書卷氣息。乘船勇闖舟山桃花島，獲初代「黃蓉」米雪帶隊遊島，深入桃花寨賞美景。享用特色黃魚宴，米雪回望接演黃蓉的深刻點滴，戲裡戲外都有不少成長！在兩部武俠小說改編電視劇演繹該角，心態上有何轉變？

獵鷹#17粵PG
programme.desc: 大偉失戀後不再利慾薰心，重新投入臥底工作，搜集一帆之罪證。文俊與雄在貨倉搬貨時，發現生果之下藏有海洛英，雄提議將部分海洛英收藏，但被崔福手下發覺將他毆打至死，文俊則受重傷，並被迫說出藏毒之所。崔福手下立刻前往取回毒品，大偉走進貨倉，見文俊受重傷，將他帶往石屋暫避，文俊已染上毒癖，在大偉勸解下前往戒毒所戒毒。江霞發現大偉的日記，方知大偉近日所作所為皆為滅罪，遂即致電告知戚幹，兩人同感錯怪了大偉。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 事主於二手網站購買演唱會門票時，遭賣方誘騙提交銀行資料並多次轉賬，損失逾十萬元。有服用情緒藥的女子在網上認識占卜師，對方聲稱可藉占卜治療其鼻疾，並要求她停服情緒藥，結果情緒問題加劇……男生於校內受到老師辱罵，嘗試以手機錄下證據，卻遭老師搶手機並強逼解鎖查閱私人內容。家長控訴該老師侵犯私隱，並有辱罵學生前科。而向教育局投訴後，其子反被校方以「情緒不穩」為由，要求社工介入評估。另帶來可改善灰甲的資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 隨着年齡增長，長者的皮膚逐漸退化，屏障變薄、油脂分泌減少，容易出現缺脂性濕疹、老人斑、灰指甲、帶狀疱疹的問題。皮膚科醫生到來，細說相關疾病的防治資訊。臨床心理學家指出，注意力可分為集中性、持續性、選擇性等多種類型。如注意力不集中，可能影響社交、降低工作效率、記憶力變差。他亦強調交替性與分配性注意力的重要性，並就提升孩子專注力提供建議。「睇餸食飯」環節，廚藝專家傅季馨示範一道「香茅白滷水豬手」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 美儀、麥包轉往佛山，有王敏慈加入「跟隊」。老城區活化後成潮人景點，中藥店「變身」咖啡店、以中式白酒調製雞尾酒的酒吧等，都甚吸引。燒鵝也有研究中心？主打燒鵝的食店，出品做到皮脆、肉嫩又多汁。坐上小型賽車，三主持極速分高下。洞穴式按摩店內，敏慈全身被埋進鹽堆中，感受如何？麥包帶兩位拍檔一秒前赴奈良？佛山的濕地公園亦可餵飼梅花鹿。行逛千燈湖夜市，麥包化身「猛男」沖檸檬茶！置身夢幻餐廳，竟是吃樹葉、木炭？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#19粵PG
programme.desc: 關仁帶眾人往石屋途中以唇語示警。君豪手下撲空，想殺淑滿，但被遠處伏擊的明翔阻止。關仁拆除淑滿身上炸藥對付君豪手下，但意外未能將已引爆的炸藥拋遠，譚彬飛撲救人受重傷。譚彬彌留前，江翹含淚戴上戒指。君豪約見江揚，展示可證明他無罪的影片，迫江揚捉高哲被拒。高哲使計令君豪欲活埋保全，再救回保全，但要他取出為江揚翻案的影片。保全潛入趙宅，得經琛相助取出影片，但逃脫時被君豪發現，君豪找勇哥買兇殺高哲等人。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#137粵

programme.title: 命轉皇后#12粵普PG

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 今回上演「是非精」大內訌，由梁嘉琪、張秀文組成「師姐隊」火併馮盈盈、張寶兒的「師妹隊」。法國人會將各式石頭應用於日常生活，當地商店一款神秘結晶石塊，究竟有何用途？台灣農莊一間看似平平無奇的房子，原來在建造時採用了一種環保物料；兩隊同時使用錦囊，得以近距離探究一番，能否猜出「用乜料」？韓國人有一種奇趣習慣，喜歡於下雨天吃煎餅，原因何在？兩隊及後分別將所得分數兌換成不同貨幣，竟換來天壤之別的結局！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫設計「絕核」對白介紹嘉賓袁文傑和高海寧，結果令Do姐忍俊不禁，有多惹笑？首爾麻浦區的綜合文化公園內，有大型建築物由廢料改建而成，兩位嘉賓可有頭緒？「泰國通」胡慧冲帶大家置身曼谷一個放着巨型飛機擺設的市集，還找來藍白色小袋子，後者原來有特別用途？鏡頭轉往台灣的鹿港，當地有夾公仔機所夾的已非公仔，更深受女士們歡迎！積分兌換貨幣環節，有人不幸打破金額新低紀錄，是哪個地區的貨幣令嘉賓「中伏」？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 生活壓力大、飲食不規律人士，胃部容易過度敏感和脆弱，繼而出現不適狀況。中醫認為可分為肝胃不和、飲食傷胃、脾胃虛寒，並就三種證型帶來舒緩茶飲，亦建議按壓兩個護胃穴位。中樞神經區域會將痛感傳至腦部，如果「訊號」被無故放大，就定義為中樞神經過敏化。物理治療師指痛楚位置會隨時日擴大且無定向，為何源自腳板的痛感會是最「嚴重」，更有可能越醫越痛？盡早求醫甚關鍵！「睇餸食飯」，Annie示範「客家梅菜燜腩肉」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 順德美食遠近馳名，首站先往大良試試雙皮奶，更有榴槤新口味；接着搜購倫教糕、蹦砂等名物做手信。品嚐順德菜大餐，敏慈吃到心儀已久的炸牛奶，還感謝美儀教她拿筷子。欣賞皮影戲後，三位主持體驗製作魚燈風鈴。來到明星食店用餐，敏慈被騙食蟲，她知悉真相後有何反應？坐小船遊覽嶺南水鄉風情，之後再嚐一碗讓美儀找回年輕記憶的拆魚羹。印尼菜館的香辣冬蔭功湯，麥包飲過即聲音變沙啞？以河鮮佳餚為這集作結，敏慈更有感性發言。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)君豪轉為低調，高哲想出運用國軒的影響力，令君豪獲「大中華慈善家獎」，引他出現。美莉詐作有孕，希望江揚不要太拚命。高哲終向蓉蓉求婚，蓉蓉應允。頒獎禮上，魔術師召君豪上台協助演出，魔術師變走君豪後變走自己。江揚發現魔術師是高哲假扮，追逐高哲時君豪恃機逃走，高哲和君豪槍戰，君豪罵高哲卻不知身上裝了收音咪，令全場及電視觀眾都知道真相。高哲脅持君豪，時江揚及蓉蓉趕至勸他收手，混亂中高哲中槍倒地……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 櫻花的花期短暫，玲玲姐姐建議大家不妨拿起紙和筆，畫下櫻花盛開的景致。她善用隨手可得的物品作畫，原來只要利用膠樽底部，就能印出漂亮的櫻花圖案！她與Emily姐姐在「Artspiration」邊作畫邊閒談，均希望可親身前赴日本賞櫻。「開心SHARE」主題是「和別人合作的經歷」。有小朋友來信分享跟好友在比賽中接力完成手作的點滴，Tiffany姐姐提到自己有類似體驗，彤彤姐姐更驚呼原來她亦曾參與相同遊戲！

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日

programme.desc: 家聰知悉Minnie對自己有意思，她卻迴避，不肯承認。家聰透過某些渠道得知其擇偶條件，於是投其所好向Minnie展示魅力，反誤中副車，令莫明詩覺得他魅力不凡。Minnie更目睹明詩與家聰經常在一起。家聰察覺明詩的心意，怕傷害她，不敢直接拒愛，想到以其他方法解決，怎料……明詩對家聰痴心一片，家聰決意對她說清楚，與她「斬䌫」。明詩提出反駁，家聰答應給她「上訴」機會，讓她接受測試……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#10粵PG
programme.desc: 紹聰被發現倒斃村屋，死時口中被甘蔗塞住，警方不排除他殺可能。負責調查的警察施敬從眾人口供得知紹聰是一億遺產的準繼承人，紹聰死前在帶弟慫恿下成立信託，帶弟遂成為眾矢之的，宏智卻選擇相信其清白。悅萍從宏智口中得知淑嫻有可疑，集合多項證據向施敬舉報。根據紹聰的死亡時間，最大得益者會是淑嫻，警方再從向南的口供驚悉紹聰的身世，淑嫻頓成最大嫌疑人。警方取得搜查令後，從淑嫻的房間中搜出了重要證物……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 師兄弟「自駕」侍奉「太后」米雪，藉四輪自行車觀賞寧波東錢湖風光。米雪憶起與黎耀祥於《大太監》拍攝太后學踏單車一幕，也提到每場戲皆會練習數十次，可見其專業態度！寧波有獨特的生腌、熟醉飲食文化，師兄弟恭送太后之後，細味「寧式十八斬」的鮮甜威力。即撈即煮更滋味，兩主持前往海上魚排捕撈海鮮，再化身「餐車廚神」炮製海鮮麵，風大火弱卻成一大難關？夕陽映照下，一嚐對方心意，為上半部的長江遊記作結，更添詩情畫意。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕澤保存母妃屍身多年，現邀秦莞燕遲前往驗屍，便發現她是中毒而亡，更讓他們懷疑起與燕遲母妃的死有關。皇后託朝羽安排被圈禁的燕徹離宮，原來一切皆在皇上的盤算之中。燕綏告訴秦莞當日自己目擊殺害母妃的人是誰…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 卓正醫療呈獻：全家健康攻略粵
獵鷹#18粵PG
programme.desc: 江霞知悉大偉做臥底，擔心其安危，從戚幹口中得知一帆乃販毒頭子，遂找一帆證實。一帆心驚但故作鎮定。一帆得知大偉真正身份，遂計劃將他置諸死地。戚幹得知江霞往找一帆，感事態嚴重，欲告知大偉，但大偉不在家，遂留下便條，但大偉見便條卻不為意。一帆派大偉往碼頭接貨，遂通知劉Sir，眾人上船搜查一無所獲。劉Sir懷疑大偉身份已敗露，但又不欲前功盡棄，只好著大偉繼續做臥底，暗中加派人手保護。一帆則預算翌日離港。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 生活壓力大、飲食不規律人士，胃部容易過度敏感和脆弱，繼而出現不適狀況。中醫認為可分為肝胃不和、飲食傷胃、脾胃虛寒，並就三種證型帶來舒緩茶飲，亦建議按壓兩個護胃穴位。中樞神經區域會將痛感傳至腦部，如果「訊號」被無故放大，就定義為中樞神經過敏化。物理治療師指痛楚位置會隨時日擴大且無定向，為何源自腳板的痛感會是最「嚴重」，更有可能越醫越痛？盡早求醫甚關鍵！「睇餸食飯」，Annie示範「客家梅菜燜腩肉」。

programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 順德美食遠近馳名，首站先往大良試試雙皮奶，更有榴槤新口味；接着搜購倫教糕、蹦砂等名物做手信。品嚐順德菜大餐，敏慈吃到心儀已久的炸牛奶，還感謝美儀教她拿筷子。欣賞皮影戲後，三位主持體驗製作魚燈風鈴。來到明星食店用餐，敏慈被騙食蟲，她知悉真相後有何反應？坐小船遊覽嶺南水鄉風情，之後再嚐一碗讓美儀找回年輕記憶的拆魚羹。印尼菜館的香辣冬蔭功湯，麥包飲過即聲音變沙啞？以河鮮佳餚為這集作結，敏慈更有感性發言。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)君豪轉為低調，高哲想出運用國軒的影響力，令君豪獲「大中華慈善家獎」，引他出現。美莉詐作有孕，希望江揚不要太拚命。高哲終向蓉蓉求婚，蓉蓉應允。頒獎禮上，魔術師召君豪上台協助演出，魔術師變走君豪後變走自己。江揚發現魔術師是高哲假扮，追逐高哲時君豪恃機逃走，高哲和君豪槍戰，君豪罵高哲卻不知身上裝了收音咪，令全場及電視觀眾都知道真相。高哲脅持君豪，時江揚及蓉蓉趕至勸他收手，混亂中高哲中槍倒地……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#138粵
programme.desc: 朋自看到「救命恩人」洛成為悅的學生後，覺地位受到動搖，大家指責朋疑心重及自卑作祟，慶更教訓朋應放下成見。朋向悅打聽她對洛的印象，毫不知情的悅竟說出理想對象正是洛這類型。朋去接悅下班，卻看到悅被洛接去。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 燕家眾人發現薛遠手上的聖旨並無蓋印，要求他回宮加蓋印章；薛遠不得不暫時離開，但同時下令不讓任何人踏出燕府半步…燕氏父子終被關押，薛遠卻沒查出罪證，謝危趁機離間聖上與薛遠。太后得知秦貴妃有孕，起了殺心…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 眾人來到位於廣州黃埔區的「波羅廟」，還找到名副其實的「波羅雞」，而要做出這款精緻手作，果然是「一味靠黐」！開平鎮濠村的「鎮濠泥雞」同樣名氣十足，四位主持一邊「吹雞」，一邊暢談與雞相關的粵語。精通中文的廖Sir與熟識潮語的麥美恩在「醫館」會診，為騎呢街坊解答「富貴於我如浮雲」、「生骨大頭菜」等講法的來源。志堅反串「剩女」，與「長腿」祖儀爭奪男神芳心，最終誰會淪為被嫌棄的「賣剩蔗」，繼續「攝灶罅」？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 昔日通勝內容上至天文地理下至英語教學，文軒飾演的騙徒被揭破奸計，皆因他「一本通書睇到老」？智堅在江門市展館拾起名物茅龍筆時遇見「幽靈」，幸得蕭博士道出茅龍筆起源，解開其心結。火水哥情迷體育健將何泳芍，運動場上全力「狗衝」，期間還有體育專家雷雄德替他解構「揼釘」、「炒芥蘭」等體育術語，追求大計能否成功？導遊帶團友品嚐「大馬站煲」卻錯摸門牌，還推說「大馬站過小馬站－ 相差不遠」，廖Sir細述相關謬誤。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 檸檬掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 柚子、佛手、魚子醬檸檬，檸檬家族規模龐大。在日本南部的高地，柚子的種植使一個村莊免於滅絕。在法國，種植一千多種柑橘類水果，其中大多數鮮為人知。在西西里島，它成為這個國家最精緻的餐桌上的美味。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 三女與秘密花園莊主初見面，踏出翠綠心靈之旅，感受晴陰，認識不同品種的植物，一草一木，靜聽當下，嘗試瞭解大自然價值和共生，還接觸雞屎藤的奇妙味道！嘉賓謝東閔應邀前來，與佳芯、美恩、穎鏇學做雞屎藤糕點，佳芯偏好怪味，穎鏇仍未衝破嗅覺的心理關口。席間，四人分享家人相處點滴，美恩、佳芯慣性報喜不報憂；穎鏇回港發展，終日掛心在美國的媽媽；東閔更自嘲是壞孩子？放鬆釋懷過後，投入「大電視」遊戲，快樂可以好簡單！

programme.title: 約埋班Friend遊香港粵
programme.desc: 想出海玩水上活動？觀塘都有得玩平板划艇，不過浚霆很快就跌落水！轉往海防博物館參觀炮台，可視為「行山」活動，但要講真正的行山經驗，有待美儀分享。再到另一歷史建築，走入前域多利監獄囚室好好「反思」；入夜歡樂時光，大揭遇過的醉酒瘋狂事件。論港式風味美食，非大牌檔莫屬，鑊氣十足！享用美食後，主持們大玩「真心話挑戰」，麥包可有呃過老婆？阿滕努力「造人」中？浚霆要即場搵人kiss、借錢，誰是「幸運兒」？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 據說泰拳沒有單一創始人，是前人在戰場上與生活中逐步累積的實戰格鬥術。一般人認為泰拳是源自泰國，谷主瀅仴卻找到某資深泰拳研究者提出，這門武術最早始於中國雲南，而用途與求偶有關？泰拳開賽前，拳手均會跳拜師舞，原來有不少含意，不同流派更各有特色。瀅仴亦簡介泰拳的比賽規則與勝負準則，並介紹一位泰拳名人，其創出的招式更促使賽會修改規則。谷主凱婷曾親身修習泰拳，體驗到這項運動在修身、減脂、塑身方面效果顯著。

programme.title: 一路前行II粵普
programme.desc: 節目由胡歌、劉濤和陳龍攜手中國國家地理融媒體中心主任張辰亮以及一眾新朋友，在節目中帶觀眾走進自然，走進科學研究員、環保愛好者和當地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 狄龍的兒子譚俊彥(Shaun)，名字由張徹導演所改，給其最直接的感覺是「不會撞名」，偏偏節目組在台灣找到另一個譚俊彥！這位譚俊彥是一名建築師，他提到於Shaun出生時已留意有相同姓名之人存在！他們前往由大師設計興建的護老院參觀，浸着腳談家庭，原來兩人對父親均不敢多言，莫非同名同姓就有近似性格？譚大師與Shaun各自駕駛私家車及電單車，抵達在大師海邊的秘密基地，Shaun不禁幻想自己年老後的生活……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 以為不易撞名，原來台北亦有一位譚俊彥老師！譚老師帶Shaun來到他於十歲前居住的萬華區，細訴自己的童年生活。Shaun還得悉了一個驚愕真相，令他覺得「好痴線」？三個譚俊彥臨時組織車隊，在卡丁車賽場來一場友誼賽，結果當然是三甲席位由譚俊彥稱霸！再到豪華露營場地，打開心窗無所不談，譚老師也笑說做過最壞的事情！雖然旅程只有三天，Shaun都為其餘兩位譚俊彥製作了紀念冊，並以結他自彈自唱送上驚喜。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿渡與阿驅是表兄弟，兩人的志願是成為星級RyuTuber，誰知一場大停電過後，兩人被吸走送到異世界，阿渡醒後發現阿驅不知所蹤，其後遇到御富良院與瑪蘿，兩人告訴阿渡他是宙部界傳說中的救世主。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 搞清三七馬步和弓步後，就可跟着兒童體適能教練「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。「下肢耐力訓練」，將右腳拉後做出三七馬步，然後重複完成提膝、上踢的動作。做熟三下側拼步後，還要聆聽指令，隨時用手碰地板呢！第二部份的「全身力量訓練」，先要重複做好三七馬步與弓步轉換的「基本步」，隨後再加入出直拳、下擋、向外揮拳、向上踢等元素，全身不同部位都能動起來！另外，這集「動物好萌友」會介紹長翅菱螳螂的習性。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮邀請戴安娜到家裡玩，不慎讓對方喝醉，巴里夫人知道後怒不可遏，禁止二人繼續來往。加拿大總理來訪，村裡大人盡出，戴安妮的妹妹米妮美卻在此時喉嚨發炎，安妮憑以往經驗盡力救治。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 隨著《強制舉報虐待兒童條例》實施，社會進一步加強保護兒童意識，傳統體罰式管教不再被推崇。然而言語暴力、「冷暴力」等，同樣可以傷害兒童，父母管教子女的界線在哪裡？坊間常言「生仔要考牌」，面對管教難題，家長應如何拿捏尺度和控制情緒？政府推動「正向教育」，可以如何改善親子關係？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 蛋散、雞仔餅、棋子餅都是中式唐餅小店提供的港人回憶味道，祥師兄到訪小店之餘，還試造燒餅，新鮮即食最好味！租漫畫曾是一種價廉物美的娛樂，數碼化年代下，仍有人堅持經營出租書店，只因不捨得多年來建立的情感。老闆為生計亦有出租影碟，隨即搜出與祥師兄有份演出的作品。大角咀某手工小菜館，將煎肉餅做到街知巷聞，由廚師變老闆，皆因不想太太受委屈？夫妻共同設計「鍾無艷煎肉餅」，有何寓意？此外，老闆亦分享煎肉餅竅門。

programme.title: 明愛暖萬心粵
programme.desc: 明愛以「愛」築起一座座於人生海洋的燈塔，為風浪裡有需要的人士點亮不滅之光。當受助者逐漸強大，同樣能發光化作下一座燈塔，讓希望不斷傳承下去。車婉婉、胡鴻鈞、潘靜文、周吉佩等都曾為追求夢想參加歌唱比賽，途中總有迷失時候，劉洋、張與辰幸得良師韋綺珊、谷婭溦在旁扶助；姚焯菲、冼靖峰和母校的學生合唱，就如為師弟妹添上愛的翅膀！歸航的道路上，更有盧冠廷與明愛之友主辦的《天生我才達人秀》眾學員合作，讓航程圓滿。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 這集為《J Music》濃縮版，會倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲的排名位置。此外，許文軒邀得新近合作的Rapper KT唐嘉麟與舞者Eden劉展霆接受訪談。一次閒聊哼唱「我想食牛肉」，Eden就成功遊說KT合作推出Rap歌？

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 運動與音樂如何相輔相成？由精英運動員組成的樂隊Chill Band，細訴成軍與演出之路。武術女將莫宛螢受傷一年後復出，在太極拳世錦賽勇奪三金，比賽心態可有變化？全港街籃混合挑戰賽引入3對3加1對1的嶄新賽制，這集搜羅初賽花絮。東方籃球隊開操備戰新賽季，還迎來新贊助商。學界體育聯會舉行週年晚宴，表揚各校健兒的表現。巴黎聖日耳門名宿尼洛特訪港，與本地小將交流。足球名帥高普召集球星，接受高難度球技挑戰。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#13粵PG
programme.desc: 廷光殺死余瑞忠，屠敏對廷光更為痛恨，原來自從屠敏十年前得知西環塌樓不是意外，而是廷光故意所為時，便與眾多受害者組成團隊，伺機向卓廷光報復。卓廷光得知有傳媒正在搜集其多年來非法收樓的黑材料，動了殺機

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend遊香港粵
programme.desc: 想出海玩水上活動？觀塘都有得玩平板划艇，不過浚霆很快就跌落水！轉往海防博物館參觀炮台，可視為「行山」活動，但要講真正的行山經驗，有待美儀分享。再到另一歷史建築，走入前域多利監獄囚室好好「反思」；入夜歡樂時光，大揭遇過的醉酒瘋狂事件。論港式風味美食，非大牌檔莫屬，鑊氣十足！享用美食後，主持們大玩「真心話挑戰」，麥包可有呃過老婆？阿滕努力「造人」中？浚霆要即場搵人kiss、借錢，誰是「幸運兒」？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 據說泰拳沒有單一創始人，是前人在戰場上與生活中逐步累積的實戰格鬥術。一般人認為泰拳是源自泰國，谷主瀅仴卻找到某資深泰拳研究者提出，這門武術最早始於中國雲南，而用途與求偶有關？泰拳開賽前，拳手均會跳拜師舞，原來有不少含意，不同流派更各有特色。瀅仴亦簡介泰拳的比賽規則與勝負準則，並介紹一位泰拳名人，其創出的招式更促使賽會修改規則。谷主凱婷曾親身修習泰拳，體驗到這項運動在修身、減脂、塑身方面效果顯著。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 三女與秘密花園莊主初見面，踏出翠綠心靈之旅，感受晴陰，認識不同品種的植物，一草一木，靜聽當下，嘗試瞭解大自然價值和共生，還接觸雞屎藤的奇妙味道！嘉賓謝東閔應邀前來，與佳芯、美恩、穎鏇學做雞屎藤糕點，佳芯偏好怪味，穎鏇仍未衝破嗅覺的心理關口。席間，四人分享家人相處點滴，美恩、佳芯慣性報喜不報憂；穎鏇回港發展，終日掛心在美國的媽媽；東閔更自嘲是壞孩子？放鬆釋懷過後，投入「大電視」遊戲，快樂可以好簡單！

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 狄龍的兒子譚俊彥(Shaun)，名字由張徹導演所改，給其最直接的感覺是「不會撞名」，偏偏節目組在台灣找到另一個譚俊彥！這位譚俊彥是一名建築師，他提到於Shaun出生時已留意有相同姓名之人存在！他們前往由大師設計興建的護老院參觀，浸着腳談家庭，原來兩人對父親均不敢多言，莫非同名同姓就有近似性格？譚大師與Shaun各自駕駛私家車及電單車，抵達在大師海邊的秘密基地，Shaun不禁幻想自己年老後的生活……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 以為不易撞名，原來台北亦有一位譚俊彥老師！譚老師帶Shaun來到他於十歲前居住的萬華區，細訴自己的童年生活。Shaun還得悉了一個驚愕真相，令他覺得「好痴線」？三個譚俊彥臨時組織車隊，在卡丁車賽場來一場友誼賽，結果當然是三甲席位由譚俊彥稱霸！再到豪華露營場地，打開心窗無所不談，譚老師也笑說做過最壞的事情！雖然旅程只有三天，Shaun都為其餘兩位譚俊彥製作了紀念冊，並以結他自彈自唱送上驚喜。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 檸檬掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 柚子、佛手、魚子醬檸檬，檸檬家族規模龐大。在日本南部的高地，柚子的種植使一個村莊免於滅絕。在法國，種植一千多種柑橘類水果，其中大多數鮮為人知。在西西里島，它成為這個國家最精緻的餐桌上的美味。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 真愛OnAir
programme.desc: 【金荷娜《Onair》詮釋辛辣女星與編劇、導演、經紀人上演修羅場！】傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸。四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執、碰撞、試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心。升雅卸下武裝、英恩學會柔軟、慶民面對情感、基俊守住信念。他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Fungal Bungle Water Friends For? - EP114
programme.desc: Kent’s extreme attempts to cure his toe fungus in time for a pool party cause the fungus to mutate and grow into a fungus-based replica of Kent himself. The Secret Lab Kids have to stop the replicant before it turns the whole lab into a stinky, sticky fungus-farm. When Kent manages to contact aliens, they land at the Edison complex and demand that the Secret Lab kids help them find a very valuable "treasure" that their planet needs. The trouble is, they don't know the earth word for this treasure - sending our kids scrambling to solve this mystery before they get turned into "shrablitz”!

programme.title: Casper the Friendly Ghost - Casper the Friendly Ghost Ep21 - EP121
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Shaq's Garage - Pilot - EP101

programme.desc: The beyond surreal adventures of Felix The Cat and his friends set in an incredibly weird and fantastical toon world where everything is alive and only dream logic rules. Each episode has three segments.

programme.title: Kidaverse Roblox Rumble - Kidaverse Roblox Rumble Ep4 - EP4

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Communication - EP116
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discover the value and importance of communication. We will learn the correct ways to communicate and the main rules of the good listener. We will know in which sites we can raise our voice and when we should respect the silence of others. We will talk about rumours and how harmful they are for effective communication.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Dignity - EP117
programme.desc: In this episode we will discover the value of dignity, finding that it goes hand in hand with self-love and self-esteem. We must value ourselves and respect ourselves first and then others. Being respectful is a rule to be able to live in harmony and dignity. It takes dignity to ask for forgiveness and to forgive!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.desc: Oh no, there's bales of hay all over the highway! Troy selects the most helpful truck he knows: Ben the Tractor!

programme.desc: Suzy had an accident and needs urgent help! Troy selects the most perfect vehicle to help rescue her: Hector the Helicopter!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Om Nom Stories
programme.desc: Sweet tooth Om Nom is wandering Around the world, eats a lot of candies and tries to find his Dream job. Watch his adventures and solve different puzzles on the way!

programme.title: Ryan Defrates
programme.desc: Ryan Defrates

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Everybody Loves a Moose
programme.desc: An oddball buddy series between an over ambitious boy, Jack and his pal Moose, a melodramatic self-confessed expert in everything. Except he isn't! Despite his best intentions, he always messes up and although Jack may not get what he want, you can't help being sucked in by Moose's relentless optimism and zest for life!

programme.title: Tom's Car Wash
programme.desc: Tom loves caring for his friends; they can always count on Tom to tow them back to his car wash, where they're guaranteed to leave sparking!

programme.title: Eliot Kid
programme.desc: When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city’s sewers transform into Indiana Jones’ white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you’ve entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

programme.title: Pumpkin Reports
programme.desc: Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Cyboars
programme.desc: Part Machine, Part Boar, All Hero!

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Things get even more epic in Season 3 as Talking Tom and Friends try new ways to make their dreams come true, making more friends (and enemies) along the way!

programme.title: Monster Town
programme.desc: Meet the Monster Trucks, a gang of colossal, hard-working cars who team up to help their friends and community in Monster City.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Bright Women
programme.desc: Karine, a 34-year-old housekeeper and devoted single mother, is thrust into leading a workers’ strike after her company is taken over. Caught between protecting her family and staying true to herself, she must make a life-changing moral choice.

programme.title: Through Rocks and Clouds
programme.desc: 8-year-old alpaca herder Feliciano is ecstatic: Peru has a chance to qualify for the World Cup. However, the scheming of a mining company is jeopardizing his village.

programme.title: Carte Blanche
programme.desc: An uplifting tale of Kacper, a charismatic high school history teacher who hides his progressing blindness from everyone around him to fulfil his educational duties. His methods are unorthodox, sometimes hilarious, and devilishly effective.

programme.title: They Say Nothing Stays The Same
programme.desc: Toichi, a solitary river boatman, watches his quiet world shift as a bridge across the river threatens to upend his livelihood. When he takes in a mysterious young girl with nowhere to go, her presence leads him toward unexpected change.

programme.title: érins IslandsMurders on the L
programme.desc: On Lérins Islands, a film producer is found dead on the set of the film adapted from the legend of the Iron Mask. As two estranged sisters investigate, the suspects begin to mirror the legend itself — each hiding secrets, betrayals and masked identities.

programme.title: The Vanishing Soldier
programme.desc: An 18-year-old Israeli soldier flees the Gaza battlefield and heads back to his girlfriend in Tel Aviv only to discover that the military elite is convinced he was kidnapped in the fog of war.

programme.title: Rafael
programme.desc: The true love story of Tunisian Nazir and his pregnant Dutch wife. They are separated when he is denied entry into Holland and so, Nazir attempts the dangerous sea crossing but ends up caught. Against all odds, his wife races across countries to free him.

programme.title: Alpha.
programme.desc: Seeking solitude after his mother’s death, Rein retreats to the Alps as a snowboard instructor. But when his boisterous father Gijs visits, tensions erupt on a treacherous mountain hike—until nature turns their rivalry into a desperate fight for survival.

programme.title: Young Tiger
programme.desc: Illegally smuggled into France to work, 15-year-old Many is unexpectedly placed in school and a foster home. Years later, thriving in the French Sikh community, Many faces a moral dilemma arising from his ties to his family in his home country.

programme.title: All The Songs We Never Sang
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Natsumi ventures from Tokyo to a small island to meet her aunt and learn the art of pearl diving (but secretly to find a treasure she was told about as a child).

programme.title: Bright Women
programme.desc: Karine, a 34-year-old housekeeper and devoted single mother, is thrust into leading a workers’ strike after her company is taken over. Caught between protecting her family and staying true to herself, she must make a life-changing moral choice.

programme.title: El Alamein - The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of searing daytime heat and chilling nighttime cold, three-time Italian Academy Awards winner Enzo Monteleone paints a gritty, powerful WW II epic of the Italian army’s battle with the Germans to drive Allied Forces from North Africa.

programme.title: Glorious Ashes
programme.desc: In the quiet fishing village of Thom Rom, lives drift and collide like tides. Duong endures a loveless marriage shadowed by another woman—Nhan—yet finds solace in her. As bonds form and vengeance stirs, three women navigate love, loss, and survival.

programme.title: Murder in Guilvinec
programme.desc: A woman dressed as a mermaid is found dead on a deserted coast — and her DNA turns up on an abandoned fishing boat with no crew aboard. As the fisherman vanishes without a trace, a haunting mystery pulls two investigators into dangerous waters

programme.title: Ghost Mountaineer

programme.title: Earth S01 - Green
programme.desc: Chris Packham tells the miraculous story of how plant life turned Earth from a barren rock into a vibrant green world - a four-billion year saga of extraordinary highs and lows that almost wiped out all life on the planet. But the early plants locked so much carbon dioxide that global temperatures suddenly plunged.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Young Veggies: Part 2
programme.desc: Supertato reveals how he learned to control his potato powers, defeat Evil Pea and save the supermarket for the very first time.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Runner Bean's Sporty Song
programme.desc: Get ready, set, dance in the supermarket aisles with Supertato, Runner Bean and the whole Tato Team! Featuring Nitro from Gladiators.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Carrot Power Song
programme.desc: Dance along with Carrot, the Tato Team's super cool, brave inventor. This song celebrates all things Carrot power!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Memory Badge
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night and Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Camping
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mount Mumandad
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Kids
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and for Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Chickenrat
programme.desc: It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy. Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead their Mum through their bizarre day in the hope of tracking her down.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the European Hamster
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer to Vienna, Austria, on a global adventure to solve the mystery of an animal behaving strangely in a churchyard. Along the way, Andy meets a wild European hamster with a taste for flowers and candle wax.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Pallas's Cats
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure to Mongolia in eastern Asia to uncover the mystery of moving rocks, only to discover it's a mother Pallas's cat out hunting for her kittens. Along the way, Andy takes a ride with a Bactrian camel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices

programme.desc: Thomas befriends a stray dog who is wandering around the railway and tries to find him a home. In the process, Thomas derails and the fuzzy little dog raises the alarm.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - The Great Little Railway Show
programme.desc: A little railway show comes to Sodor and a misunderstanding leads to all the small engines on railway turning up at Ulfstead Castle to participate.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Thomas and the Forest Engines
programme.desc: In Brazil, Thomas meets two wood-burning engines who've never travelled beyond their eucalyptus railway.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Fatberg, London Sewers, England
programme.desc: While Lars, Kelly and Xuli go into the sewers to help keep London clean, Glitch and the Grimbots create some enormous blockages after flushing wet wipes down the toilet.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Monteverde Cloud Forest, Costa Rica
programme.desc: A feather duster drama unfolds high in the Monteverde Cloud Forest when Glitch's feather collecting goes wrong. Can the Go Jetters save a rare bird's nest and find a lost trophy?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - The Continent of Africa
programme.desc: Glitch takes Tala to the continent of Africa to help her with an Academy project. When the pair get lost, the Go Jetters need to crack the clues and find them in this huge continent.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Flock and Roll
programme.desc: It's hard enough for Mojo and Bo to help Jackson get all his sheep back in their pen, but it's even harder when the hungry sheep start chewing up Preston's flower festival!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Wingsuit Yourself
programme.desc: Tao needs help learning to fly his new wingsuit for a big town event, and Mojo and Bo are the experts. Can they help him find his inner bird before it's too late?

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Melon Melon
programme.desc: Evil Pea befriends the playful but destructive Baby Watermelon to destroy Tato Tower. Her plan backfires when Baby Watermelon gets cranky.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Freezy Sprinklers
programme.desc: Evil Pea plots to take over the whole supermarket by making fake freezy sprinklers to fool Supertato. But what is her real plan, and will Supertato stop her?

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Carrot Power Song
programme.desc: Dance along with Carrot, the Tato Team's super cool, brave inventor. This song celebrates all things Carrot power!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veg-O-Vision Song Contest Song
programme.desc: It's Veg-O-Vision time and Rylan Clark has some amazing fruit and veggie songs for you!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Veggie Birthday Song
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team have a veggie birthday song for you. Sing and dance along!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all singing all dancing extravaganza while the other, a serious drama. Can Duggee and the squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Memory Badge
programme.desc: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it! He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Going Slow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace. However, they come across Tortoise who needs to get to the hospital as his wife is having babies. Duggee and the Squirrels need to get him there fast!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night and Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mount Mumandad
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Kids
programme.desc: A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and for Dad however, he is a very naughty boy.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Chickenrat
programme.desc: It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy. Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead their Mum through their bizarre day in the hope of tracking her down.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Neighbours
programme.desc: Bluey needs her Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's own growing stable of animals.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Pallas's Cats
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure to Mongolia in eastern Asia to uncover the mystery of moving rocks, only to discover it's a mother Pallas's cat out hunting for her kittens. Along the way, Andy takes a ride with a Bactrian camel.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Swollen Nosed Side Blotched Lizard
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet to the Sea of Cortez in Central America to rescue a swollen-nosed side-blotched lizard. They discover its taste for salty seafood means it sneezes out the excess salt. Along the way, Andy goes swimming with some acrobatic sea lions.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death – a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fête. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.
